title: Principal scalar cones normalized against derived tensor
statement: For the coefficient categories and uniformizer endomorphism d of [det-pe-derived-nakayama-resolution], with the scalar power identity on cochain complexes, there are natural isomorphisms Q Cone(d^(n+1)) ≅ Q followed by right derived tensor with the pulled-back quotient module in degree zero, for each n≥0. They take cone.map(d,id) to tensoring the specified quotientStep of [sk-def-pe-derived-completion], and cone.inr to the right-unitor inverse followed by tensoring ε_Q and Q(single.map(finiteUnit)). With the standard derived tensor shifts of [def-weil-triangulated-category], they intertwine the inverse mappingCone.shiftIso and the shift comparison of Q. This statement makes no identification with derived extension followed by restriction.

proof.text: Use derived_nakayama_resolution to obtain the exact pulled-back coefficient sequences. The section formula identifies its uniformizer endomorphism with the supplied d by extensionality; its quotient maps agree with quotientUnit by module-morphism extensionality. Transport through regularPullbackIso on the first two objects. Act by endomorphisms of the monoidal unit using the center-induced commutative scalar ring: the left-unitor scalarOnComplex equals scalar times the identity, and conjugated pullback preserves scalar products.

proof.text: The quotient units followed by quotientStep agree definitionally on underlying coefficient functions, hence agree as module morphisms. Their pulled-back versions give finiteUnit_step. The scalar power equality and whiskerLeft_reductionIso_hom then give the transition formula after cancellation of the two reductionIso components. reduction_reductionIso_hom, followed by cancellation of one component, gives the exact specified tensor-unit formula for cone.inr.

proof.text: Apply lem-pe-reduction-iso-signed-shift to the same fixed canonical reductionIso components. scalarOnComplex comes from a termwise natural scalar action, so it commutes definitionally with cochain shifts. Transporting this equality through the cone gives the exact inverse mappingCone.shiftIso square. The right-tensor shift is the standard tensorReductionShift, so no shift structure is chosen or changed.

theorem principal_cone_tensor_normalization
    (d : End (Mod.regular (DerivedNakayama.integerRing l E)))
    (hd : ∀ (S : Profinite.{u}ᵒᵖ) (a : (DerivedNakayama.integerRing l E).obj.obj S)
      (s : S.unop), ((d.hom.hom.app S) a).down s =
        Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E * a.down s)
    (hs : ∀ (n : ℕ) (M : CochainComplex (AdicCompletion.Modules l E X) ℤ),
      DerivedNakayama.scalarOnComplex l E X (d ^ (n + 1 + 1)) M =
        DerivedNakayama.scalarOnComplex l E X d M ≫
          DerivedNakayama.scalarOnComplex l E X (d ^ (n + 1)) M) :
    ∃ (κ : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedNakayama.coneFunctor l E X (d ^ (n + 1)) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ DerivedNakayama.reductionFunctor l E X (n + 1)),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (M : CochainComplex (AdicCompletion.Modules l E X) ℤ),
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainComplex.mappingCone.map
          (DerivedNakayama.scalarOnComplex l E X (d ^ (n + 1 + 1)) M)
          (DerivedNakayama.scalarOnComplex l E X (d ^ (n + 1)) M)
          (DerivedNakayama.scalarOnComplex l E X d M) (𝟙 M)
          ((Category.comp_id _).trans (hs n M))) ≫ (κ n).hom.app M =
            (κ (n + 1)).hom.app M ≫
              (DerivedNakayama.reductionMap l E X
                (AdicCompletion.quotientStep l E n)).app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj M)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (M : CochainComplex (AdicCompletion.Modules l E X) ℤ),
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr
          (DerivedNakayama.scalarOnComplex l E X (d ^ (n + 1)) M)) ≫
            (κ n).hom.app M =
          (ρ_ (DerivedCategory.Q.obj M)).inv ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.obj M ◁
            (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε DerivedCategory.Q ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map
              ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).map
                (AdicCompletion.finiteUnit l E X n)))) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (r : ℤ) (M : CochainComplex (AdicCompletion.Modules l E X) ℤ),
        DerivedCategory.Q.map
            (CochainComplex.mappingCone.shiftIso
              (DerivedNakayama.scalarOnComplex l E X (d ^ (n + 1)) M) r).inv ≫
            (DerivedCategory.Q.commShiftIso r).hom.app
              (CochainComplex.mappingCone
                (DerivedNakayama.scalarOnComplex l E X (d ^ (n + 1)) M)) ≫
            ((κ n).hom.app M)⟦r⟧' =
          (κ n).hom.app (M⟦r⟧) ≫
            (DerivedNakayama.reductionFunctor l E X (n + 1)).map
              ((DerivedCategory.Q.commShiftIso r).hom.app M) ≫
            (Functor.commShiftIso (self := tensorReductionShift l E X n)
              (DerivedNakayama.reductionFunctor l E X (n + 1)) r).hom.app
              (DerivedCategory.Q.obj M))
